shortDescription: Create, update or delete an UptimeRobot Public Status Page

options.name: api_key
options.description: UptimeRobot API key. See C(uptimerobot_monitor) for the resolution order.

options.name: api_key_file
options.description: Path to a file whose first line is the UptimeRobot API key. Tilde-expanded.

options.name: custom_domain
options.description: Custom domain to host the status page under (e.g. C(status.example.com)). Mutually exclusive with I(custom_url).

options.name: custom_url
options.description: Backward-compatible alias for I(custom_domain) - this is also the field name UptimeRobot uses on the read side. Mutually exclusive with I(custom_domain).

options.name: friendly_name
options.description: Display name of the status page. Used as the idempotency key, so it must be unique on the account.

options.name: hide_url_links
options.description: When C(true), the rendered page does not show the underlying monitor URLs.

options.name: monitors
options.description: Monitors to display on the status page. Each item references an existing monitor. When an item has I(id), it is used directly. Otherwise I(friendly_name) is resolved against C(getMonitors); an unknown name fails the play.

options.name: password
options.description: Password to protect the status page. UptimeRobot never returns the stored value, so re-running the task with I(password) set always reports C(changed=true). Omit to keep the previous password.

options.name: sort
options.description: Sort order of the monitors on the page.

options.name: state
options.description: C(present) creates the PSP when missing, or updates it in place when present. C(absent) deletes it; when the PSP does not exist, the module exits with C(changed=false).

options.name: status
options.description: C(active) un-pauses the page, C(paused) pauses it. Only honoured on edit; UptimeRobot rejects this field on create.
